problem: It says the processor runs a fixed sequence "at every sample", then lists autoranging and self-calibration. Those do not run on every sample: self-calibration is done periodically or on command, and autoranging only when the signal moves to a new range. A student may write that all seven functions execute each sample.
fix: Say the processor runs the sequence continuously, with some steps at every sample (linearisation, offset/gain, temperature compensation) and others periodically or on command (self-calibration, autoranging, self-diagnosis).

where: Figure spec, digital bus node note
problem: The bus node note "I²C, HART" puts HART beside a true digital bus. HART is a low-level FSK digital signal riding on the 4–20 mA analog current loop, not a bus like I²C, and the figure can mislead on that point.
fix: Use a note such as "I²C, SPI, HART on 4–20 mA" so the loop-based nature of HART is visible in the figure.
